sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A storm-themed fight that relocates the squad twice (80% and 60% health) and punishes standing still. 9-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Unbridled Tempest
bullets: An expanding wave of lightning that deals lethal damage — get above it on a tornado, teleport past it, or use invulnerability. You cannot outrun it on foot.

sections.heading: Tornadoes
bullets: Regular tornadoes can be ridden to escape Unbridled Tempest, but touching one while affected by Violent Currents triggers Shocking Barrage (strips stacks, sends out damaging waves) — know your stacks before you touch one.
A separate red Titanic Twister deals massive damage on contact — don't confuse it for a safe tornado.

sections.heading: Breakbar
bullets: 15,000 total defiance bar — breaking it triggers Bolt Break, an unavoidable lightning strike on everyone, so time your breaks with your healing/defensives up.
She targets the highest-toughness player, same as Adina.
